ResearchProjectDef.label: weapon mounts
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a braced rest that holds a handheld ranged weapon in place for a gunner, extending its range and steadying its aim.

ResearchProjectDef.label: reinforced mounts
ResearchProjectDef.description: Machined recoil cradles and sandbagged fronts: mounts that shoot farther, steadier and give their gunner better cover.

ResearchProjectDef.label: armored emplacements
ResearchProjectDef.description: Plasteel-shielded gun emplacements with stabilized cradles, giving the gunner heavy cover and the best manned accuracy.
